messages:
Alex M.: Quick heads-up — I'm running a short cross-team sync for the 'Smart Routing' initiative. Need RFC review + explicit sign-offs for scope gates before we freeze the spec on Monday. Main points: customer-driven fallback behavior, per-route latency SLAs, and audit/logging expectations. Who can take acceptance criteria and edge cases today?
Maya C.: I can grab acceptance criteria and perf targets. Drop the latest RFC/PRD link pls.
Alex M.: <https://redwood.internal/prd/smart-routing|PRD draft> — see section 3 (Acceptance) and 5 (Edge cases). Also added a short decision log at the bottom.
Lee H.: I'll review the UX flows and error state copy. Quick question: what should the client see during a cross-region fallback (spinner, partial output, clear message)?
Dan R.: Infra note: cross-region fallback increases tail latency and has cost implications. Hard constraints: per-region 99.9% availability target, fallback TTL = 30s, and rate-limits need override policy. We should add these as non-negotiable infra gates.
Ravi K.: Also add KV cache invalidation rules to RFC — when we switch model variants the cache keys must be invalidated to avoid serving incompatible prefixes.
Priya S.: From Sales: BrightHealth and two others want deterministic routing + audit trails for regulatory reasons. We need a clear matrix that maps Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private behaviors and what we can commit to.
Alex M.: Draft acceptance checklist (quick):
```
- [ ] Must route to primary region if capacity available
- [ ] Fallback to regional replica within 300ms median extra latency
- [ ] Audit log entry for every fallback event (user_id, route, model_variant)
- [ ] KV cache invalidation documented and tested on model swap
- [ ] UX shows "Routing to backup" toast + partial streaming preserved
- [ ] Rollback policy defined and can be triggered via Console + API
```
Maya C.: Couple of edge cases to call out: network partition where replica exists but has different model version; partial streaming where tokens stop mid-chunk; and retries that might violate idempotency for function calls. I'll flesh these into the RFC.
Lee H.: UX edge case: if user is on a long streaming response and fallback happens, we should preserve partial output and show a silent switch rather than an error. Mocking that now.
Dan R.: For the decision log: we need to pick a safety threshold for fallback — e.g., only fallback automatically if 95th percentile latency > SLA *and* queue depth > X. Otherwise trigger canary failover.
Ravi K.: Also propose adding a quality gate: if fallback model causes >2% drop on rerank test set, auto-revert and create incident. We can wire this to the Optimize alerts.
Alex M.: Good — I'll add both thresholds to the doc. One more ask: Priya, can you produce the customer matrix by EOD? Sales needs it for the account sync.
Priya S.: Yep — I'll post the matrix here by 16:00.
Maya C.: Can everyone add a quick :thumbsup: reaction to this thread when you finish reviewing the acceptance criteria? We need explicit sign-off from Eng, Design, Infra, and Sales before Monday freeze.
Lee H.: Added comments on UX copy. Not comfortable with "Routing to backup" phrasing — feels alarming. Suggest "Switching to faster route" or similar.
Dan R.: Small infra ask: include a failsoft mode that drops to synchronous short responses (limit tokens) rather than queue growth. Need that in rollout plan.
Alex M.: Noted. I'll add failsoft mode and a rollout checklist (canary -> region-wide -> global).
Ravi K.: One more technical edge: when model variant differences are semantically breaking (tokenizer/special tokens), fallback must abort and surface an error to the app with explicit error code. Will document codes.
Alex M.: Can we converge on final acceptance criteria by EOD? If so, I'll assemble a one-page launch gate with owners and put it into the Launch board.
Priya S.: Matrix posted: gist with Hosted/Dedicated/Private commitments (link posted in thread).
Maya C.: I left a couple of inline perf numbers — need clarification on SLO target (99ms vs 150ms median). Which do we pick?
Alex M.: Let's compromise: 100ms median for premium routes, 150ms for standard. I'll mark premium in the PRD and map customers.
release-bot: Reminder: launch freeze starts Monday 09:00 UTC — please complete sign-offs before then.
Lee H.: UX sign-off from my side once wording is updated (I put suggested copy inline).
Dan R.: Infra sign-off pending on exact fallback trigger numbers (I'll post them as a short PR).
Ravi K.: Engineering sign-off pending unit tests for cache invalidation and a small regression eval. Will merge after tests.
Priya S.: Sales sign-off — we can commit to provided matrix for BrightHealth pilot, pending a short legal review.
Alex M.: Great. Action items: Alex -> publish gate doc (by EOD), Maya -> finalize acceptance criteria (by EOD), Dan -> post fallback trigger PR (tomorrow morning), Ravi -> tests + eval (tomorrow), Lee -> update UX copy (today), Priya -> legal pass + customer matrix (EOD). Please add :thumbsup: here once you personally sign off. Thanks everyone — will assemble a decision log entry after we get reactions.
Maya C.: :thumbsup:
Lee H.: :thumbsup:
Priya S.: :thumbsup:
Ravi K.: :thumbsup:
